note: Madden NFL 99 rates the 1998 NFL season. Every player of its 30 clubs but the punters and long snappers, as NFL Draft Buzz's copy of EA's data lists them: [name, franchise (scripts/data/nfl-teams.json), the site's position, game position, overall, { no: jersey, score, from: team page or list, attributes }], written by scripts/sync-madden-early.mjs. The overall is ours, not the game's (conversion).

source.compiler: NFL Draft Buzz, Madden Ratings Database (June 2026): EA's ratings, its compilation; the players' names its matcher's (name, team, position and jersey against Pro-Football-Reference ids)

conversion.overall: Ours, not the game's: Madden NFL 99 kept its players' attributes but no overall. Each player's attributes are weighted as Madden NFL 2001's overall weights them (least squares on its EA overall, by group: QB THP THA AWR SPD AGI ACC; RB SPD ACC AGI AWR STR CAR; WR SPD ACC AGI AWR CTH; TE SPD ACC AGI AWR STR CTH; OT AWR STR AGI PBK RBK; OG AWR STR AGI PBK RBK; C AWR STR AGI PBK RBK; DL STR SPD ACC AGI AWR TAK; LB SPD ACC AGI AWR STR TAK; CB SPD ACC AGI AWR TAK CTH; S SPD ACC AGI AWR TAK CTH; K AWR KPW KAC), ranked among the season's players at his game position (mid-rank percentile, ties sharing one) and read off Madden NFL 2002's overalls at that position (the 2001 season: maddenratings.net's 31 team spreadsheets, punters left out), as many of each Madden team's best as the season carries per club, by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1–99. A generic defensive back (DB) plays safety where nflverse lists him at safety that season, else corner.
